task: Search ArXiv for papers with 'Graph Neural Networks' in the abstract that were submitted between Jan 1, 2024, and Jan 3, 2024, and determine how many of these papers have more than five authors.
answer:
FINAL: 2 papers have more than five authors among the 3 arXiv results with the exact phrase “Graph Neural Networks” in the abstract and original submission dates from January 1–3, 2024, inclusive:
• Saliency-Aware Regularized Graph Neural Network — 7 authors; submitted January 1, 2024. https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00755
• Graph Neural Networks in Intelligent Transportation Systems: Advances, Applications and Trends — 10 authors; originally submitted January 1, 2024. https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00713
The remaining result, Strong Transitivity Relations and Graph Neural Networks, has 2 authors. https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01384
